exceptions.business_justification: AWS Free Tier learning POC deliberately avoids the paid AWS WAF service.
exceptions.compensating_control: NGINX ModSecurity with OWASP CRS protects application API traffic. The S3 origin is private through CloudFront OAC, public access is blocked, HTTPS is enforced and security response headers are enabled.

exceptions.business_justification: AWS Free Tier learning POC uses S3-managed AES-256 encryption instead of a chargeable customer-managed KMS key.
exceptions.compensating_control: The bucket is private, all public access is blocked, ownership is enforced, versioning is enabled and CloudFront accesses objects only through Origin Access Control.
